nodes.guardrail: Before deepening economy/tech, verify opponent's early pressure potential and own defensive readiness. If opponent shows early aggression or own defense is weak, prioritize defensive structures and units over further expansion.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent composition or pressure becomes clearer.

nodes.guardrail: Before adding air units, confirm opponent's anti-air capabilities and own economy stability. If opponent has strong anti-air or own economy is unstable, prioritize ground army reinforcement and defensive positioning.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or air presence changes.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing production, ensure scouting has revealed opponent's composition and pressure timing. If scouting is insufficient or opponent shows early pressure, prioritize defensive units and map vision.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent pressure or composition is known.

nodes.guardrail: Before developing further, verify map control and opponent's intentions. If map control is contested or opponent's intentions are unclear, prioritize defensive positioning and scouting over expansion.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when map control or opponent intentions are clearer.

nodes.guardrail: Before continuing tech, confirm opponent's tech path and army composition. If opponent shows tech that counters your planned composition, adjust tech choices accordingly and maintain a balanced army.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.

nodes.guardrail: Before expanding, verify opponent's defensive capabilities and potential counterattacks. If opponent has strong defense or can punish expansion, prioritize harassment and defensive units over expanding.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent defense or tech changes.

nodes.guardrail: Before strengthening ground army, confirm opponent's tech and army composition. If opponent has tech that counters ground forces, consider adding air support or adjusting composition.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition is known.

nodes.guardrail: Before considering air defense, verify opponent's air presence and own anti-air capabilities. If opponent's air presence is unclear or own anti-air is insufficient, prioritize scouting and defensive structures.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when opponent air presence becomes clearer.

nodes.guardrail: Before committing to a path, ensure scouting has revealed opponent's composition and intentions. If scouting is incomplete, prioritize defensive play and maintain flexibility in tech choices.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck when more scouting information is available.
